our_extension: Reuses Transformer encoders in local emotion inference with recorded checkpoint and preprocessing identity; introduces no new attention theory.

prior_contribution: Established bidirectional pretraining followed by supervised task fine-tuning.
our_extension: Adapts pretrained encoders to seven emotion labels with frozen partitions and recorded training/evaluation provenance.

prior_contribution: Demonstrated multilingual BERT transfer and documented limitations across languages and settings.
our_extension: Adds language-compatible checkpoint discovery and separates declared training coverage from verified evaluation coverage.

prior_contribution: Introduced XLM-R and analyzed multilingual pretraining scale and capacity trade-offs.
our_extension: Packages XLM-R fine-tuning on declared Hindi-English and French-English partitions while preserving the source-data and split contract.

prior_contribution: Designed MuRIL for Indian-language representations, including transliteration-related supervision.
our_extension: Routes MuRIL only to Hindi-English and declines French-English emotion-checkpoint selection, preserving the supported language scope.

prior_contribution: Benchmarked code-switched NLP and investigated adaptation using generated code-switched data.
our_extension: Adds explicit synthetic-data opt-in, dataset hashes, frozen split manifests and grouping checks to generated-data training.

prior_contribution: Created Hindi-English emotion data with linguistic annotations of emotional expression.
our_extension: Carries language-pair identity and an explicit seven-emotion schema into validation and evaluation without inventing missing corpus labels.

prior_contribution: Used emoji prediction as distant supervision for transferable affective representations.
our_extension: Implements an optional learned text-emoji gate with sequence embeddings and an exact zero contribution when emoji are absent; its accuracy contribution is unevaluated.

prior_contribution: Defined a multilingual emoji prediction benchmark using English and Spanish tweets.
our_extension: Adds paired emoji-removal diagnostics and explicit variant-label or invariance requirements before scoring changed inputs.

prior_contribution: Defined annotated binary and fine-grained irony detection tasks.
our_extension: Separates auxiliary sarcasm supervision from emotion, masks unknown labels and prevents output from an untrained sarcasm head.

prior_contribution: Compared context-aware and isolated-utterance sarcasm analysis.
our_extension: Implements bounded context encoding with current-message token priority and context-trained checkpoint capability checks.

prior_contribution: Defined conversational emotion recognition and emotion-flip reasoning for Hindi-English and English dialogues.
our_extension: Adds bounded prior-turn context and speaker-specific predicted-emotion change traces, without representing label changes as causal flip explanations.

prior_contribution: Studied neural miscalibration and temperature scaling.
our_extension: Adds validation/calibration-only fitting, checkpoint-bound profile validation, guarded overlap rejection and preserved class predictions.

prior_contribution: Showed uncertainty degradation under dataset shift.
our_extension: Records calibration data scope and synthetic status and prevents application to a mismatched checkpoint; does not claim distribution-shift robustness.

prior_contribution: Evaluated predictive uncertainty from deep ensembles.
our_extension: Provides sequential heterogeneous-checkpoint comparison for resource-constrained inspection, retaining each model distribution rather than claiming ensemble-calibration equivalence.

prior_contribution: Introduced Shannon-entropy-based divergences including Jensen-Shannon divergence.
our_extension: Applies base-2 Jensen-Shannon divergence and square-root distance to aligned seven-emotion checkpoint distributions.

prior_contribution: Formalized selective neural classification with a risk-coverage trade-off.
our_extension: Provides inspectable reasons for selective review routing; configured thresholds remain operational heuristics without certified risk bounds.

prior_contribution: Preserved individual subjective judgments through multi-annotator modeling.
our_extension: Creates two blinded review sheets, keeps model suggestions separate, preserves reviewer information and requires reconciliation before correction export.

our_extension: Creates audited correction exports that retain source and synthetic provenance, add accepted corrections to training only and protect frozen evaluation rows.

our_extension: Adds paired raw, normalized, emoji-removed and contextual input variants with row-level records, overlap checks and explicit label-validity rules.
